response.answer: 1. Brand: Salomon [1][2] 2. Model name: Fastlane [1][2] 3. Model year: 2026 (F/W 2025/26 season) [1][3] 4. Model status: New model for 2026 — first year of production [4][5] 5. Predecessor model: Replaces the Salomon Super 8 in the freeride lineup (Super 8 discontinued after ~10 seasons) [6][7] 6. SKU: L47947100 (153cm example) [8] 7. Gender: Unisex [9] 8. Product type: Snowboard [1] 9. Manufacturer headquarters: Annecy, France [10] 10. Parent company: Amer Sports (headquartered Helsinki, Finland) [11] 11. Amer Sports ownership: Owned by consortium including Anta Sports, FountainVest Partners, Anamered Investments, and Tencent [12] 12. Salomon founded: 1947 by François Salomon in Annecy, French Alps [10][13] 13. Design center: Salomon Annecy Design Center (ADC), ~400,000 sq ft facility with ~750 employees [14] 14. Snowboard manufacturing location: Primarily manufactured in China [15] 15. Salomon skis manufactured in: Amer Sports factory in Altenmarkt, Austria (skis, not snowboards) [14] 16. Warranty: 2-year limited warranty covering materials and craftsmanship [4] 17. Board category: Freeride-Powder (merchant verified) [1] 18. Board category (disagreement — Blauer Board Shop): All-Mountain / Carving [5] — Note: Most other sources agree on Freeride. Blauer's categorization emphasizes the board's carving capability but is not representative of the consensus. 19. Terrain: Freeride, Powder, Steep, Off-piste, Backcountry (merchant verified) [1] 20. Riding style: Aggressive, high-speed, precision (merchant verified) [1] 21. Rider level: Advanced to Expert [1][3][5] 22. Use case description: "hard charging freeride board built for steep and deep terrain" [2][3] 23. Forum characterization: "Want to not turn at all and just bomb? Fastlane." [6] 24. Shape: Tapered Directional (tail narrower than nose) (merchant verified) [1] 25. Tail shape: Pin tail (merchant verified) [1][2] 26. Taper amount: Tail slightly tapered 2–20mm [16][17] 27. Taper benefit: Loosens up turn initiation and improves flotation in deeper snow without sacrificing edge hold on hardpack [16] 28. Camber type: Backseat Camber (camber under back foot, flat under front foot) (merchant verified) [1][2] 29. Camber description: Camber loaded under the back foot for precision and control, with flat segments under the front foot for superior flotation in deep snow [2][3] 30. Nose design: Longer rockered nose for easier turn initiation and float [5][18] 31. Sidecut type: Quadratic Sidecut (mix of elliptic curves) (merchant verified) [1][2] 32. Sidecut description: A blend of elliptic curves for easy turn initiation, effortless direction changes and fluid edge-to-edge transitions [2][3] 33. Flex rating (merchant verified): 9/10 [1] 34. Flex rating (Blauer Board Shop scale): 5/5 (Stiff) [5] 35. Flex description: Stiff (merchant verified) [1] 36. Flex feel (evo characterization): Stiff; evo rates Salomon flex 6-8 = stiff on their standardized scale [19] 37. Forum impression of flex: "Fastlanes tail is a plank" — extremely stiff tail [6] 38. Width category: Standard (merchant verified) [1] 39. Flex direction: Directional flex — stiffer tail for stability and drive [5][18] 40. Core material (merchant verified): Aspen SLCT Core (hand-selected Aspen wood strips) [1] 41. Core name (Blauer Board Shop): Aero Core [5] — Disagreement: The merchant says "Aspen SLCT Core" while Blauer Board Shop refers to it as "Aero Core" and Blue Tomato calls it "FSC-certified Aspen SLCT core". These likely describe the same core with different marketing emphasis — Aero referring to weight, SLCT to the wood selection process. 42. Core certification: FSC Certified wood core [20][21] 43. Core description: Combines ultralight, strong and responsive wood for the lightest feel underfoot and power on demand; every single wood strip is hand-selected [3] 44. Popster technology: Yes (milled core inside inserts for more natural flex and extra pop) (merchant verified) [1] 45. Popster description: Core is strategically milled inside of the insert packs, allowing the board to flex more naturally underfoot and transfer energy into the nose and tail for added pop [3] 46. Damplifier technology: Yes (ABS and cork insert in nose to absorb vibrations) (merchant verified) [1] 47. Damplifier description (Blue Tomato): Damplifier insert for reduced swing weight [22] 48. Laminate (merchant verified): B/FX Ultra (flax and carbon natural fibers), BA MD Fiberglass (medium density) [1] 49. B/FX Ultra description: A patented combination of basalt and flax designed to provide superior dampening, power, and weight reduction [16][23] 50. Laminate (Blauer Board Shop alternate reference): Ghost Carbon Beams [5] — Note: Blauer lists "Ghost Carbon Beams" as an additional laminate; this may be inaccurate or a different tech feature mixed in from another product. 51. Sidewall material (merchant verified): 66% Recycled ABS [1] 52. Sidewall material (disagreement — REI): 100% recycled ABS sidewalls [24] — Note: Multiple sources (Corbetts, Boardsport Source) agree on 66%, while REI lists 100%. This is a significant discrepancy; the merchant and industry trade source (Boardsport Source) both say 66%. 53. Sidewall technology: ABS molecular structure provides toughness for energy transfer and dampening properties for impact absorption [25] 54. Base (merchant verified): 50% Recycled Sintered Base [1] 55. Base type: Sintered EG base [16] 56. Resin (merchant verified): 30% Bio-Based Resin (plant material) [1] 57. Resin description: Bio-epoxy resin made with 30% of its molecular structure derived from plants [16] 58. Recycled edges: 20% recycled steel edges [22][23] 59. Topsheet material: Olive wood veneer [22][23] 60. Topsheet description: Premium, light, strong, and stylish [26] 61. Base finish (merchant verified): Fine Stone Finish [1] 62. Base finish description: Particularly efficient on Sintered EG base, speeds up in powder or softer snow conditions [16] 63. Factory wax (merchant verified): Natural Wax [1] 64. Natural wax description: A paraffin-free wax compound made from natural ingredients, non-pollutant held to highest standards of glide speed [16] 65. Mounting pattern (merchant verified): 2x4 Inserts [1] 66. Mounting pattern description: Standard insert pattern allowing for a wide range of stance options and compatibility with most bindings [4] 67. Edge bevel: All-Mountain Edge Bevel — precision-tuned edges from 1-degree through sidecut to 2-degree bevel between feet [27][28] 68. Recycled content summary: 50% recycled base, 66% (or 100% per REI) recycled ABS sidewalls, 30% bio-based resins, 20% recycled edges [23][24] 69. FSC certification: FSC™-certified wood core [20][29] 70. Eco-friendly wax: Paraffin-free natural wax [16] 71. Sustainability pledge: Salomon pledged by 2030 to reduce overall carbon emissions by 30% and create 100% of products with circular economy principles [30] 72.
